# Incremental Reconcile

This feature processes merged pull requests and direct commits incrementally based on a certain watermark. It allows developers to efficiently update the knowledge base with only the changes made since the last successful compile.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.reconcile`
